facts.text: Melanie and her family have a tradition of going camping during the summer, where they roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire, and enjoy each other's company.

evidence.quote: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer!

facts.text: Melanie and her family went camping last year and saw the Perseid meteor shower, which they described as an amazing experience where the sky was lit up with streaks of light.

evidence.quote: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light.

facts.text: Melanie and her family experienced a meteor shower that felt awe-inspiring, with the sky filled with stars and a sense of being part of something larger.

evidence.quote: The sky was so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.
